profile.headline: at Google
profile.summary: I'm interested in machine learning, data mining, and natural language understanding at scale.  I specialize in large scale neural network models for text and semantic data.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I'm currently managing a research team and building scalable neural network models for understanding text and semantic data.  I've worked on the Google Knowledge Graph, large scale machine learning and information extraction systems, and natural language understanding backed by semantic databases.

positions.title: Data Wizard
positions.description: I lead a team that developed novel machine learning and data mining systems on a Hadoop compute cluster using graph-structured semantic data.  We worked to discover the data that makes up Freebase.com.

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description: At SRI, I developed machine learning and semantic data processing systems for an intelligent assistant.  Projects included a research prototype that became Siri, Apple's mobile assistant, and the CALO project, the largest DOD funded artificial intelligence project ever.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I played lead technical role in numerous projects at a wireless start-up. Responsibilities encompassed system and software architecture, design, implementation, delivery, and support of large hosted software solutions.
